absence_information.question: If I am unable to attend a class or event due to illness or a personal reason, whom should I inform? Will I have an opportunity to make up for my absence?
absence_information.answer: If a volunteer is unable to attend a class or event due to illness or a personal reason, they must inform the Teaching and Technical Wing in advance by sending an email. All volunteers will have sufficient opportunities throughout the semester to make up for any absences. It is the responsibility of the wing to ensure that such opportunities are provided.

committee_change.question: If I am initially allotted to a particular committee after the interview, will I have an opportunity to change it later?
committee_change.answer: The initial committee allotted might change upon vacancies and as per your interest but there is no guarantee to it, moreover the initial allotment will be done on the basis of interests.

committee_selection.question: How can I get selected for a particular committee in the Teaching and Technical Wing?
committee_selection.answer: Volunteers for a particular committee will be selected based on their interview score and skill set by the sub-coordinators and co-ordinators of the wing. However, volunteers can inform about their particular preference if any during the time of the interview.

emergency_contact.question: In case of an emergency or any complaints/questions, whom should I contact?
emergency_contact.answer: In case of an emergency or if you have any questions, you should first contact the concerned POC. If you do not receive a response, you may reach out to any sub-coordinator of your committee. If the issue remains unresolved, you can then contact the head sub-coordinator. Finally, if you still have any grievances or complaints, feel free to contact the coordinators. Remember, we are always here to support and help you!

hours_monitoring.question: Will there be a system in place for volunteers to monitor their hours throughout the semester?
hours_monitoring.answer: Volunteers will be able to view the points they have earned through the Teaching and Technical Wing once or twice every month. Final hours will be displayed only after the semester ends.

hours_requirement.question: How many hours will I obtain from the Teaching Wing? How many hours am I required to complete in the first and second semesters?

incomplete_hours.question: What will happen if I am unable to complete the required number of hours? Can I complete my remaining hours from other NSS activities?
incomplete_hours.answer: If you are unable to complete the required number of hours in the Teaching and Technical Wing, you will not be considered to have passed NSS. You must complete 80 hours (or the final decided number) over the course of two semesters.

info_leave_policy.question: Leave Policy
info_leave_policy.answer:
\\t1 Inform via email in advance
\\t1 Makeup opportunities provided

leave_semester.question: Can I choose to leave the Teaching and Technical Wing at the end of the first semester?
leave_semester.answer: Leaving the Teaching and Technical Wing at the end of the first semester is allowed, but only if you have completed 40 hours. If your total is less than 40 hours and you still wish to leave, you must complete the remaining hours in the second semester through teaching activities, even if you are no longer part of the Teaching Wing.

sub_divisions.question: What are the various sub-divisions existing in the Teaching Wing and what are their functions?
sub_divisions.answer:
There are a total of three sub-divisions existing in the Teaching Wing:

1. Core teaching Committee: Responsible for all activities related to teaching. Teaching activities can range from teaching in government schools, conducting events in various schools, technical teaching in schools and tutorial blocks to even online teaching.

2. Events Committee: All the events that happen in the institution related to social activity are managed by the Events Committee. It includes Event management, Logistics, seating arrangement, event decision and execution.

3. Social Media & Photography Committee: Graphic designing for posts and video editing for reels for the official social media The Teaching and Technical Wing. Also responsible for handling the photography and videography at the events.

teaching_opportunity.question: If I am part of the Events or Social Media & Photography Committee, will I still have the opportunity to teach students?
teaching_opportunity.answer: Teaching students is the most touching and fulfilling part of being in the Teaching and Technical Wing. We believe every volunteer deserves to experience it, so no matter which committee you're in, you'll have the opportunity to take part in teaching activities.

transportation.question: Will there be a transportation facility available for volunteers? Will NSS provide compensation for transportation costs?
transportation.answer: Transportation facilities will not be available for volunteers. Since the schools are located nearby, volunteers are encouraged to use their own bicycles. Please note that NSS will not reimburse any transportation expenses.

tshirt_policy.question: Is it compulsory to buy the Teaching and Technical Wing T-shirt? Am I required to wear it at all times?
tshirt_policy.answer: Yes, it is mandatory for every volunteer to purchase the T-shirt, as it is compulsory for volunteers from all NSS wings to buy their respective T-shirts. Wearing the T-shirt will be required while taking classes or attending events.
